description: tl;dv records and transcribes meetings, then uses AI to generate highlights, summaries, and action items. It creates timestamped notes that link directly to key moments in the recording.

name: Raycast AI
shortDescription: AI-powered launcher and productivity tool for macOS
description: Raycast is a macOS launcher with built-in AI features. It provides quick access to AI chat, translations, code explanations, and custom AI commands — all from a keyboard shortcut.
features: Extension ecosystem for tools and services

name: Todoist AI
shortDescription: Task management app with AI-powered task suggestions
description: Todoist's AI assistant helps break down tasks, suggest due dates, and organize your to-do list. It takes natural language input and converts it into structured, actionable tasks.

name: ClickUp AI
shortDescription: AI features embedded across ClickUp's project management platform
description: ClickUp AI generates task summaries, writes documents, creates subtasks, and automates workflows within ClickUp. It acts as a contextual AI assistant across all ClickUp features.
features: AI writing for docs and tasks
Automatic task summaries and standup reports
Contextual AI across all ClickUp views

name: Consensus
shortDescription: AI-powered academic research search engine with sourced answers
description: Consensus searches through peer-reviewed research papers to answer scientific questions. It synthesizes findings across studies and provides citations for evidence-based answers.

name: Elicit
shortDescription: AI research assistant that finds and analyzes academic papers
description: Elicit helps researchers find relevant papers, extract key findings, and synthesize information across studies. It automates systematic literature review workflows for academics and analysts.

name: Semantic Scholar
shortDescription: AI-powered academic search engine by Allen Institute
description: Semantic Scholar uses AI to index and understand 200M+ academic papers. It provides semantic search, paper recommendations, citation analysis, and AI-generated summaries of research.

name: scite.ai
shortDescription: AI tool showing how research papers cite each other
description: scite analyzes millions of citation contexts to show whether papers support, mention, or contradict each other. It helps researchers evaluate the reliability of scientific claims.

name: Connected Papers
shortDescription: Visual tool for exploring academic paper relationships
description: Connected Papers creates visual graphs of related academic papers. It helps researchers discover relevant work by showing connections between papers based on citations and semantic similarity.

name: NotebookLM
shortDescription: Google's AI research assistant that works with your documents
description: NotebookLM by Google lets you upload documents and have AI conversations grounded in your sources. It generates summaries, answers questions, and creates audio overviews from your content.
features: AI grounded in your uploaded documents
Inline citations linking to source passages

name: SciSpace
shortDescription: AI assistant for understanding and exploring research papers
description: SciSpace helps users understand complex research papers with AI explanations, text highlighting, and follow-up questions. It simplifies academic reading for students and researchers.
features: Highlight and ask questions about text

name: You.com
shortDescription: AI search engine with customizable research modes
description: You.com is an AI-powered search engine that offers multiple modes including Research, Writing, and Code. It synthesizes information from web sources with citations.
features: AI search with multiple modes (Research, Chat, Create)
Custom AI agents for specialized tasks

name: Wolfram Alpha
shortDescription: Computational knowledge engine for math, science, and data

features: Computational answers to math and science queries

features: Socratic tutoring that guides rather than answers
Covers math, science, computing, and humanities

name: Duolingo Max

features: Gamified learning with streaks and rewards

name: Coursera Coach

name: Photomath
shortDescription: AI math solver that explains step-by-step solutions
description: Photomath uses AI to solve math problems from camera photos or typed input. It provides detailed step-by-step explanations and animated walkthroughs for learning.

name: Quizlet Q-Chat
shortDescription: AI tutor that helps students study with adaptive flashcards

features: Performance tracking and weak area identification

name: Gradescope

features: AI-assisted answer grouping for faster grading

name: Med-PaLM

description: Med-PaLM by Google DeepMind is a large language model fine-tuned for medical knowledge. It answers clinical questions with expert-level accuracy and provides reasoning for its diagnoses.

name: PathAI
shortDescription: AI-powered pathology platform for diagnostic accuracy
description: PathAI uses machine learning to improve the accuracy and efficiency of pathology diagnosis. It assists pathologists in identifying cancer, grading tumors, and quantifying biomarkers.

name: Viz.ai
shortDescription: AI-powered care coordination for stroke and cardiac events
description: Viz.ai uses deep learning to detect strokes, pulmonary embolisms, and other critical conditions from medical imaging. It automatically alerts care teams to speed up treatment.
features: AI detection of stroke from CT scans
Pulmonary embolism and aortic disease detection

name: Paige AI
shortDescription: AI platform for cancer detection in pathology

name: Ada Health
shortDescription: AI-powered symptom assessment and health guidance app
description: Ada Health is an AI-powered symptom checker that helps users understand their health conditions. It provides personalized assessments based on symptoms and guides users toward appropriate care.
features: AI symptom assessment with high accuracy

name: Harvey

name: CaseText (CoCounsel)

name: Upstox AI
